name: Being Set Apart
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to be distinct from the world, chosen by Christ and therefore not loved by the world as it is. This set-apart life involves not being conformed to worldly patterns but being transformed through the renewal of the mind, offering ourselves as living sacrifices holy and acceptable to God. Christians are to live by faith in the Son of God, putting on Christ and resisting fleshly desires, while remaining in the world but protected from evil through God's keeping.
